name: Acceleration-Aware Forecasting Protocol Omega
author: Vincent Boucher
purpose: Forecast realized outcomes under changing capability, cost, task duration, automation, reliability, adoption, bottlenecks, and possible regime transitions.

canonical_model.plain_language: Realized output is the lesser of technically deliverable capacity and absorptive demand, after residual bottlenecks.
canonical_model.hard_min_limit: As rho tends to infinity, the generalized family approaches the branch-specific hard minimum.

evidence_grades.A: Primary, directly measured, audited, or independently reproducible
evidence_grades.B: Strong independent analysis with transparent data and methods
evidence_grades.C: Indirect, self-reported, survey-based, or incompletely reproducible
evidence_grades.SYNTHETIC: Generated under declared code, seed, and parameters

default_recalculation_rule: min(30 days, 0.1 times forecast horizon), or earlier on forecast break, trigger, or regime change
